assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic contributors to these symptoms.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is required to identify the underlying rhythm disturbance responsible for the recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness.
The symptoms are consistent with the member's documented sick sinus syndrome diagnosis.
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is coded as CPT 93226.
The sick sinus syndrome diagnosis is coded as Z86.73.
The sick sinus syndrome diagnosis is coded as I49.5.
